entry_cap_semantics: TC adds the existing fixed 20% unit-scoped strategy cap while disabling the heuristic entry veto. The unchanged 30% system/base limit and all missing-data/entry guardians still apply. It does not scale realized returns after a run.
held_risk_semantics: Keep the entire existing held policy, including one reduction toward 10% and the rare extreme exit; preserve all common base exits. No new threshold or altered trigger.

analysis.interval: Unadjusted descriptive percentile 95% for net total return and maximum drawdown only; other metrics are full-window point diagnostics. Pair all cells within each resample. Report all six contrasts; no confirmatory winner selection.
analysis.seed: SHA256(experiment request semantic digest + ':' + contrast name)
analysis.trailing_block: included in all full-window point estimates; excluded only from complete-block resampling
analysis.decomposition: TR-T = (TC-T) + (TE-TC) + (TR-TE); ordered conditional interventions, not order-independent component ownership
analysis.unidentified: Filter-versus-cap interactions are not separately identified in either held regime; filtering without the 20% cap, cap-only with held risk, and reduction versus extreme-exit effects are not separately identified. No additional cells may be added after reading results.

acceptance.old_T_TR_anchors: Exact equity/daily-return/final-ledger bytes and all recorded decision business fields including no-fill/no-action rows under bijective event-coordinate mapping; omit only formal decision digest containing physical/experiment identity. Complete native entry governance equality is also checked during replay. Held governance and accounting code are unchanged. Fail before new cells if either anchor differs.
acceptance.cold: Own previously independently constructed prerequisites, fresh physical members and complete producer-identity proof, independent process, kernel filesystem/network isolation and exact business artifact reproduction
